title: Schema of replacement
summary: The image of a set under a definable single-valued correspondence is a set.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared first-order set theory context is fixed.

content.plain: The image of a set under a definable single-valued correspondence is a set.
content.exact: For each formula φ(x,y,p̄), if φ is functional on A, then ∃B∀y[y∈B↔∃x(x∈A∧φ(x,y,p̄))], with the usual schema conditions.
content.example: Applying a definable successor construction to every member of a set produces a set of successors.
content.caveat: Functionality and the exact schema conditions matter; replacement is not an arbitrary collection rule.
